research_question: Do supervised transformation training and prediction consistency improve post-processing robustness over the clean frozen-CLIP baseline?

data.test_policy: Do not extract or inspect transformed test results until E2/E3 settings and validation threshold rules are frozen.

paired_training.pair_definition: Each transformed embedding is paired to the clean embedding with the identical image_path and true label.
paired_training.condition_sampling: Every non-clean representative condition occurs once per training image per epoch.
paired_training.initialization: Existing E1 clean linear-probe coefficients and intercept.

E1.name: clean_linear_baseline
E1.loss: Clean binary cross-entropy used in Section 2.

E2.name: supervised_clean_plus_transformed
E2.training: Fine-tune the linear head on clean/transformed pairs with true labels.

E3.name: supervised_plus_consistency
E3.training: Use the identical E2 pairs, batches, optimizer, and initialization, adding only consistency loss.

model_selection.epoch_metric: Unweighted mean ROC-AUC over clean and all six representative transformed validation conditions.

threshold_selection.objective: Maximize unweighted mean balanced accuracy over clean and all six representative transformed validation conditions.
threshold_selection.tie_break_2: Lower threshold, favoring AI recall when all prior criteria tie.
